freeze_rule: Frozen before any final test label was read. Changing any value requires a new protocol version with an independent rationale; the prior version is preserved.

canonical.endpoint_definition: For one own published post, seven-day impressions greater than that author's historical median impressions, measured on the author's own prior published observations only.
canonical.unit_of_observation: one retained impressions observation for one own published post

label.rule: A label exists only when a retained observation of the endpoint metric was captured between publication+6d and publication+8d and carries a real observed value. A single later total for the same post is not a seven-day measurement.

forecast_time.definition: publication time of the target post
forecast_time.feature_cutoff: forecast_at; no feature may be observed after it

partitions.maturity_rule: Every training label must have matured strictly before the earliest calibration forecast time, and every calibration label strictly before the earliest test forecast time. Rows falling inside a maturity gap are excluded, never reassigned.

grouping.derivation: publication identity, plus any retained repost/duplicate/event linkage; copies of the same event share one group and may not straddle partitions

dependence_block.definition: author/client x ISO week of publication
dependence_block.resample: sample len(blocks) blocks with replacement, take all rows of each

baselines_predeclared.definition: pooled base rate of y on the training partition only
author/client historical rate on the training partition, shrunk to the pooled training rate with pseudo-count k=20
simple historical ordering by (topic_category, format) cell rate on the training partition, shrunk to the pooled training rate with pseudo-count k=10

candidate_model.optimizer: full-batch gradient descent, fixed schedule, deterministic
candidate_model.probability_calibration: Platt scaling of the model logit, fit on calibration only
features: log1p body character length at publication
forbidden_features: any observation of the target post itself
any value observed at or after forecast_at
outcome-derived selection flags such as is_winner

display_conditions.band_interval: 95% block-bootstrap interval of the observed rate
display_conditions.skill_reference: strongest (lowest Brier) predeclared baseline on the untouched test

statuses.insufficient_data: no numeric likelihood is displayed, no effectiveness claim is made, and the exact missing requirements and populations are reported
statuses.experimental: a likelihood may be logged privately for later comparison but never displayed and never described as validated
statuses.validated_for_scope: every display condition passed on the untouched test block, and display is limited to the declared scope

forecast_persistence.identity: sha256 over (client_id, brief_id, version, content_hash, protocol_hash, model_version)
forecast_persistence.idempotence: editorial_brief_artifacts primary key (client_id, brief_id, version, artifact_role='forecast') and unique (client_id, request_id) make a replay collide instead of creating a second forecast
forecast_persistence.immutability: editorial_brief_versions_immutable and editorial_brief_artifacts_immutable block update/delete, so a later observation cannot mutate the original prediction
forecast_persistence.later_edit: a new brief version creates a new forecast and preserves the previous one

prohibited: fabricating a seven-day value from an older total
turning a missing metric into zero
using an outcome-selected discovery cohort as an evaluation population
tuning on the untouched test block
describing a successful evaluator execution as predictive effectiveness
